description: OpenAI Whisper multilingual speech recognition family (whisper-tiny architecture). KV-cache streaming decoder with greedy or beam-search decoding, optional translate and timestamp/segment output; long audio (>30s) is auto-split on quiet-energy boundaries. Supports offline and streaming (sliding-window) transcription.

request.name: language
request.description: Whisper ISO-639 language for the transcription prompt (en/zh/ja/ko/...). Use `auto` for single-step language detection. Defaults to en.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum generated tokens per utterance; zero uses a 64-token default.

request.name: task
request.description: transcribe (ASR) or translate (transcribe into the target language, Open AI Whisper semantics: English).

request.name: timestamps
request.description: Emit word/speech segments with timestamps (model outputs <|timestamp|> tokens within the 30s window).

request.name: beam_size
request.description: Beam search width. 0 or 1 => greedy KV-cache streaming; >=2 => beam search (per-candidate single-batch forward with per-beam KV state round-trip, no framework batch rewrite). May increase transcription quality at higher latency.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Repetition penalty applied to the logits of already-generated tokens (OpenAI semantics: negative logit multiplied, positive divided). 1.0 (default) disables it; >1.0 suppresses degenerate repeats. Required for usable beam search (beam_size>=2 without it collapses into whole-sentence repetition). Values <=1.0 are clamped to 1.0.

request.name: clip_offset_seconds
request.description: Global start offset (seconds) of the fed audio in the source timeline. When >0 and timestamps=true, inject a start-timestamp token (<|X.XX|>) into the decoder prompt so the model conditions on 'this fragment begins mid-stream' and suppresses boundary artifacts at chunk start. Must align with how long the audio snippet was cut from its source.

request.name: clip_timestamps
request.description: OpenAI-style clip_timestamps [start,end] (seconds) as string, e.g. "[125.4,155.4]". The start value is used as the global start offset (see clip_offset_seconds); takes precedence when both are present. Mainly for R1/R2 jump-transcription passthrough.

request.name: audio_chunk_mode
request.description: Long-audio segmentation (framework contract): auto (default, quiet-energy), fixed (fixed window), vad (real Silero VAD split), none (no split). Old whisper-only values quiet_energy are still accepted and treated as auto.

session.name: vad_model_path
session.description: Path to the internal Silero VAD model directory used when audio_chunk_mode=vad (default: assets/framework/models/silero_vad). You can also pass the fully-prefixed key whisper.vad_model_path.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: ggml weight context arena size in MiB; default 128. Overrides the compile-time kWeightContextBytes (was 128).

session.name: graph_arena_mb
session.description: ggml graph context arena size in MiB; default 64. Overrides the compile-time kGraphContextBytes (was 64).

session.name: cross_kv_precision
session.description: Cross-attention KV storage precision: f16/bf16/f32 (default f32).

download.reason: No packaged download yet. Convert locally with audiocpp_gguf (--family whisper) to a standalone F16 GGUF, or prepare a safetensors model dir with config.json + multilingual.tiktoken + model.safetensors (see docs/models/whisper.md).
